title: Event ID 4104 Script Block Log — Download Cradle Detected
event_type: Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational channel, Event ID 4104 (Script Block Logging)

fields.label: CorrelatedNetworkEvent
fields.value: DNS query for 203.0.113.55 from same host/ProcessGuid, +42s after 4104 event

callouts.explanation: Contains both a fetch primitive (Net.WebClient/DownloadString) and an execution primitive (IEX) in the same script block, matching DET-10-02's composite condition rather than just the process name.
Confirms the script actually reached out to the referenced host within the 5-minute correlation window, distinguishing an executed download cradle from a comment or unused string.
Ties the script-block event to the host process lineage so the DNS/connection event can be joined to the exact PowerShell process that logged the 4104 entry, not merely the same host.

Identifies this as a Script Block Logging record (4104) rather than a process-creation event, which is the detection surface DET-10-02 moved to because it captures the code that ran, not just that powershell.exe launched.

note: This is an illustrative, conceptual field breakdown of what a matching Event ID 4104 entry and its correlated network event would contain; it is not a captured screenshot and depicts no product interface.
